title: Bayesian Parametric Portfolio Policies
abstract: arXiv:2602.21173v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Parametric portfolio policies map predictors into portfolio weights without modelling returns, making them a natural tool for factor timing. With many predictors, if the policy has more coefficients than observations the data cannot pin it down. We develop Bayesian Parametric Portfolio Policies (BPPP), which discipline the policy with a prior, update it with realised utility, and average the weights over the posterior. We contribute to the factor-timing literature by estimating timing as a portfolio rule rather than from return forecasts. With 242 predictors and five factors, BPPP earns 2.08 percentage points a year from timing, mostly from aggregate anomaly returns. Under a leverage limit, averaging sizes each position by its uncertainty and comes close, without a separate scale choice, to the size that maximises timing with hindsight. A turnover penalty preserves significant gross timing at lower turnover.

translated_title: 贝叶斯参数化组合策略
translated_abstract: 参数化组合策略将预测变量直接映射为组合权重，而无需对收益率进行建模，这使其成为因子择时的天然工具。当预测变量较多时，如果策略的系数多于观测值，数据便无法唯一确定该策略。我们提出了贝叶斯参数化组合策略，通过先验分布对策略施加约束，利用已实现效用对其进行更新，并在后验分布上对权重进行平均。我们对因子择时文献的贡献在于，将择时估计为一种组合规则，而非基于收益率预测。在242个预测变量和五个因子的情况下，BPPP通过择时每年获得2.08个百分点的收益，主要来自总体异象收益。在杠杆限制下，后验平均可以按各头寸的不确定性来确定其规模，无需单独选择规模参数，即可接近事后最大化择时收益的规模。换手率惩罚在降低换手率的同时，仍保留了显著的毛择时收益。
tldr: 本文提出贝叶斯参数化组合策略（BPPP），通过先验约束和后验权重平均解决预测变量多于观测值时组合策略无法确定的问题，在242个预测变量和五个因子下通过因子择时每年获得2.08个百分点的收益。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Bayesian Parametric Portfolio Policies (BPPP), which discipline portfolio rules with priors and posterior weight averaging when predictors exceed observations, earning 2.08 percentage points per year from factor timing with 242 predictors and five factors.
